_about: The narration of the batnet film, one scene per entry. `text` is spoken (ElevenLabs); `caption` is what the subtitles show, in plain English; `pad` is the pause after it, in seconds; `min` is the scene's least length. Spellings like 'ze' and 'ven' are on purpose: the narrator has a thick German accent. Edit here, then `python3 video/render.py` (see video/README.md).

scenes.text: batnet. Ven ze grid goes down, ze village keeps talking.
scenes.caption: batnet. When the grid goes down, the village keeps talking.

scenes.text: Berlin, January last year. One fire in a cable tunnel, and fifty thousand homes go dark for three days. No light, no heating, and after a few hours no mobile network: ze masts have batteries for exactly long enough to be useless. Zis is not a film. Zis happened.
scenes.caption: Berlin, January last year. One fire in a cable tunnel, and fifty thousand homes go dark for three days. No light, no heating, and after a few hours no mobile network: the masts have batteries for exactly long enough to be useless. This is not a film. This happened.

scenes.text: Now imagine every third house has a small radio node. Ze lights are out, but ze street is talking: who has a generator, which pharmacy is open, who needs insulin.
scenes.caption: Now imagine every third house has a small radio node. The lights are out, but the street is talking: who has a generator, which pharmacy is open, who needs insulin.

scenes.text: Every house: one Raspberry Pi, ze size of a packet of cigarettes, on a power bank. It makes an open WiFi. Your phone joins, opens ze browser, and zere is a chat app. Like WhatsApp, but no internet, no account, no company. Houses link to each ozer over WiFi mesh, and over ze hills by LoRa radio: cheap, legal, a few kilometres on a good day. No Enigma machine required: ze village key is a QR code on ze admin's phone.
scenes.caption: Every house: one Raspberry Pi, the size of a packet of cigarettes, on a power bank. It makes an open WiFi. Your phone joins, opens the browser, and there is a chat app. Like WhatsApp, but no internet, no account, no company. Houses link to each other over WiFi mesh, and over the hills by LoRa radio: cheap, legal, a few kilometres on a good day. No Enigma machine required: the village key is a QR code on the admin's phone.

scenes.text: Glastonbury. Two hundred thousand people, one hill, and a mobile network zat surrenders by Friday lunchtime. Pocket nodes on power banks, one per camp, linked by radio across ze fields.
scenes.caption: Glastonbury. Two hundred thousand people, one hill, and a mobile network that surrenders by Friday lunchtime. Pocket nodes on power banks, one per camp, linked by radio across the fields.

scenes.text: A child is lost near ze stage: ze alert reaches every camp in under a minute.
scenes.caption: A child is lost near the stage: the alert reaches every camp in under a minute.

scenes.text: Zen: a bang, somewhere by ze west field. Everyone reports it. Everyone sees ze reports, so nobody runs ze wrong way, and ze medics see exactly where to go.
scenes.caption: Then: a bang, somewhere by the west field. Everyone reports it. Everyone sees the reports, so nobody runs the wrong way, and the medics see exactly where to go.

scenes.text: Black Rock City. Four kilometres across, a city built for one week in ze Nevada desert, nothing between you and ze horizon but dust. Perfect for radio: eight nodes cover ze whole city. A whiteout comes in, and 'stay in camp' reaches everyone before ze dust does.
scenes.caption: Black Rock City. Four kilometres across, a city built for one week in the Nevada desert, nothing between you and the horizon but dust. Perfect for radio: eight nodes cover the whole city. A whiteout comes in, and 'stay in camp' reaches everyone before the dust does.

scenes.text: Ve do not guess. Ze real code runs in a simulator: forty houses, a bang, two hundred and forty-seven posts, every one delivered. Zen ve take it to ze field.
scenes.caption: We do not guess. The real code runs in a simulator: forty houses, a bang, two hundred and forty-seven posts, every one delivered. Then we take it to the field.

scenes.text: batnet. Open source, cheap, and it works ven nothing else does. Ve haff vays of making you talk... to your neighbours.
scenes.caption: batnet. Open source, cheap, and it works when nothing else does. We have ways of making you talk... to your neighbours.
